```{=html}
<script>
window.filterListingCategory = function(category) {
  const decode = value => {
    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(atob(value));
    } catch {
      return value;
    }
  };

  for (const list of Object.values(window["quarto-listings"] || {})) {
    if (category === "") {
      list.filter();
    } else {
      list.filter(item => {
        const raw = item.values().categories || "";
        return decode(raw).split(",").includes(decode(category));
      });
    }
  }
};
</script>
```
